milestone: Native text storage anatomy and cross-layer sharing plan
status: Qualified storage/scheduling component; full inference objective remains active

implementation.architecture: BnModelNativeAnatomy contains native safetensors IDs (separate from GGUF), tensor geometry, compressed pool/index ownership, candidate mode and Engram rows.
implementation.bindings: Validates main attention FP8/E8M0 block-32 pairs, BF16 norms/router/compressors/index keys, F32 sinks/HC parameters/biases, shared expert matrices, Engram int4/F16 scale storage and projection, and embedding/head/norm. No tensor payload reads.
implementation.coverage: Rejects unrecognized layer core tensors; main routed expert namespace is handled by existing trellis catalog. Auxiliary MTP and vision namespaces excluded.
implementation.ownership: Optional bn_model_prepare_native_anatomy setup stage before backend publication; model owns immutable plan and releases it after backend resources. Errors preserve existing model/catalog and output plan.
implementation.limits: Storage/scheduling only. Numeric execution settings remain in owned JSON; no full numeric validation, quant execution capability or forward/generation admission is added.

validation.synthetic_tests: Independent core namespace fixture with small geometry and zero payloads; missing tensor, dtype, shape, scale shape, extra unknown core tensor, invalid owner/index/candidate geometry and model rollback/teardown checked under ASAN/UBSAN.

reference.scope: Original kv_source/make_attn method bodies execute with a fake parent recording constructor arguments; latest full index source tracked per original shared-selection contract. This is a topology reference, not numerical full-model inference.

limitations: Full numerical execution planning, FP8/core kernels, HC4 carry-pre execution, sqrtsoftplus routing, indexed/compressed attention, Engram hashing and generation remain unfinished.
Actual FFN tests use deterministic inputs and frozen independent FFN references, not full-model hidden states.
Compressed GPU payload bound excludes context/library, request tensors/workspace and host storage/cache/staging.
RSS/timing are diagnostic, not total-system, storage-cold or throughput benchmarks.
WASM dependencies were updated but WASM and NEON were not validated here.
